title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Cool Flames Investigation with Gases

sources.title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Cool Flames Investigation with Gases

key_findings: Steady-state cool diffusion flames on spherical porous burners.
Cool diffusion flames burning propane, n-butane, and n-pentane.
Cool diffusion flames for a wide range of Zst, Tad, and pressures.

Cool diffusion flames for which a decrease in fluent flow rate will cause extinction, whereas an increase will cause a transition to a hot diffusion flame, with oscillation possible between hot and cool flames.
fields.earth_applications: This research aims to facilitate the development of more efficient internal combustion engines by advancing the understanding of cool flame kinetics.
